Figure 9.17: TP PDU Direct Gatewaying with Forwarding to Upper Layer
The I-PDU must be buffered in the PDU Router since the DCM module is not aware of
that it will be Gatewayed to CAN2. Such gatewaying is controlled by the configuration
and cannot be processed by the DCM.
